title: Internal: Opening Business Savings Accounts
summary: This document provides the step-by-step procedure to open a business savings account (account_type='savings') for eligible customers, including identity verification, requiring an OPEN business checking account open ≥30 days with ≥$2,500 balance, limiting savings accounts to <4, and prohibiting negative balances. It uses open_bank_account_4821 with the customer-selected account_class (e.g., Bronze Saver Account, Silver Saver Account, etc.) and optionally transfers the opening deposit via transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291; if the customer doesn’t fund now, they have 30 days via internal transfer or external deposit or the account will be closed.
faqs: What are the eligibility requirements to open a business savings account?
